decisions.decision: Old-money editorial look: paper/cream backgrounds, warm brown ink, camel accent, beige hairlines, heritage signal colours (forest / ochre / brick). Clean and quiet: no gradients, glows, glass or neon.
decisions.source: 21st theme 'Vintage Paper' by serafimcloud (https://21st.dev/community/themes/vintage-paper), adapted to the project's existing CSS tokens
